sections.heading: Websites, SEO & AI automation that win Geelong businesses more customers
sections.subheading: We build websites that turn visitors into enquiries, get you found on Google and ChatGPT, and automate the admin that eats your week. Built in-house by developers and AI engineers. Fixed prices. No lock-in.

sections.label: About Drivwon
sections.question: What is Drivwon?
sections.answer: Drivwon is a digital studio in Geelong, Victoria, founded in 2026 by AI engineer Sahil Raval. We help small and medium businesses get found (SEO, AI search and Google Ads), win customers (websites, online stores and AI chatbots) and get time back (AI agents and workflow automation). Websites start from $1,800 and SEO from $650 a month, with no lock-in contracts.

sections.heading: Three ways we grow your business
sections.intro: Most agencies do one piece. We connect all three, so every part of your business works toward the same goal: more customers for less effort.

items.title: Get found
items.body: SEO, AI search (ChatGPT and Google AI), Google Ads and social media — so the right people find you before your competitors.

items.title: Win customers
items.body: Fast websites, online stores and AI chatbots that turn visitors into calls, bookings and sales.

items.title: Get time back
items.body: AI agents and workflow automation that handle quotes, emails, data entry and follow-ups for you.

sections.heading: Everything you need, under one roof
sections.intro: Pick one service, or let us plan the full system. Every project starts with a free call and a fixed written quote.

sections.heading: Built by engineers. Focused on results.
sections.intro: Many marketing agencies outsource the technical work. We are developers and AI engineers, so we build it properly ourselves — and measure what it brings in.

items.title: Engineers, not resellers
items.body: Design, code, SEO and AI are built in-house. Nothing is passed to another agency.

items.title: Real credentials
items.body: Founded by an AI engineer with a Master of Applied AI from Deakin University (High Distinction) and AWS certification.

items.title: Every lead tracked
items.body: Calls, forms and bookings are tracked, so you can see exactly what your money brings back.

items.title: No lock-in, no fluff
items.body: Fixed written quotes, month-to-month plans and honest advice — even when the answer is “you don’t need this”.

items.title: Ready for AI search
items.body: We build your site so ChatGPT, Google AI and Perplexity can understand and recommend your business.

items.title: Local to Geelong
items.body: A Geelong business you can call or email, who knows the Surf Coast and Bellarine markets.

sections.heading: Simple, from first call to more customers

steps.title: Free 20-minute call
steps.body: Tell us what you want to grow. You get honest advice and no sales pressure.

steps.title: Your plan and fixed price
steps.body: A clear written plan, price and timeline — usually within two business days.

steps.title: We build, you approve
steps.body: We design and build in-house and show you progress along the way.

steps.title: Launch, track, improve
steps.body: We go live, track every lead and keep improving month by month.

sections.heading: Proudly local to Geelong
sections.intro: We work with businesses across the Geelong region and Australia-wide.
